sections.instruction: Complete the answers to the questions using MYSELF, YOURSELF, ITSELF etc. (Example: Who repaired the bicycle for you? – Nobody. I repaired it myself.)

questions.prompt: Did Brian have his hair cut by a hairdresser? – No. He cut [gap].
questions.explanation: he did it without help → himself

questions.prompt: Do you want me to post that letter for you? – No, I’ll [gap].
acceptedAnswers: post it myself|post the letter myself|do it myself
questions.explanation: I’ll do it without help → myself

questions.prompt: Who told you that Linda was getting married? – Linda [gap].
acceptedAnswers: told me herself|herself told me|told me so herself
